## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the left arm to pull the handle of the medium-sized rectangular microwave with textured top.

Task description: The target is the medium rectangular microwave in the center of the table, with a textured top. Use the left arm to pull the vertical handle on the right side of the door and open it.

Success criteria: Use the left arm to pull the handle and open the oven door to at least 60% of its maximum travel. Pulling it open only a crack does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Grip a vertical-handle section away from upper and lower joints with adequate rear clearance, surrounding it from left and right. Avoid the two knobs to the handle's right when facing the oven door.
- Match the gripper opening to the handle width and nearby clearance. Before closing, confirm the fingers actually enclose the handle rather than only pressing its front or the door panel.
- While pulling, adjust the pull direction and wrist pose along the door’s actual rotation arc, avoiding slipping or jamming by pulling continuously along a fixed straight line.
- The microwave is next to the Rubik's cube on its left. Watch the sweep of the door and left arm and adjust in small steps based on visible clearance to reduce collision risk.
